API /api/auth/register detects founder email and sets is_founder=true, username='Motesart', special avatar

UI: Founder login shows Motesart logo avatar with crown icon
UI: Crown icon appears in navbar for founder only
UI: User dropdown shows correct avatar and display name
UI: Founder dropdown shows 'Motesart' name with crown icon
seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing - testuser@example.com and motesartproductions@gmail.com
